jobs.title: About usWho we are and how we work
jobs.description: ✕ Home Platform Ads & analytics Channels CRM & pipeline Automation & AI Managed services Industries Case studies Blog About us Careers Get in touch What we're doing Marketing software has a handoff problem. Vendors ship features and leave implementation to whoever bought them. Agencies rent tools they can't change. Both models leave the same gap, and it's the gap where most marketing programmes quietly stall. We closed it by doing both jobs under one roof. 2015Building marketing technology since 5Offices across three continents 20+Modules in the platform BothSoftware and services, one company How we work Four things we hold to Ship, then judge Opinions about a campaign are worth less than two weeks of data. We get things live and let the numbers settle the argument. One platform, not a stack Every module shares the same data. We'd rather deepen one system than ship a second tool that needs syncing to the first. Clients own everything Accounts, data, domains and audiences stay with the client. If we're not adding value, leaving should be easy. Operators write the roadmap The people running client accounts file the feature requests. Nothing gets built because it demos well. The story How we ended up here Where it started On-site personalisation, then everything else The first product answered a narrow question: what should this specific visitor see right now? Answering it properly meant collecting behaviour, geography, traffic source and purchase history — and once that data existed, every other channel wanted to use it. What changed Customers kept asking for the next module Email, then SMS and WhatsApp, then ads, then a CRM to hold the leads all of it produced. Each was added because someone was already exporting data to a separate tool to do it, and that export was where things broke. Where we are A platform, and a team who lives in it Managed services started because customers asked us to run what we'd built. It turned out to be the best product feedback loop we have: nothing survives contact with an operator who has to use it every morning. Early enough that your work still shows. The platform is broad but young. Most of what it will be in three years hasn't been built yet, and the people joining now are the ones who'll decide what it becomes. Open roles Where we are Five offices, one product team Delivery sits close to the markets it serves. The platform is built in one place so it stays one platform. New York, USA North American accounts and partnerships. Kraków, Poland Engineering and platform delivery. Athens, Greece Campaign delivery across southern Europe. Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Gulf market accounts and Arabic-language campaigns. Tel Aviv, Israel Headquarters, product and R&D. Work with us, or come work here. Get in touch fortvision.
